probable_cause: quote-processor-prod Lambda function is hitting its concurrency limit with 450 throttles in 1 minute during the expected 2-4pm EST peak submission window, likely due to reserved concurrency set too low or a slow downstream dependency (RDS/DynamoDB) holding connections longer than expected.
immediate_actions: Check reserved concurrency for quote-processor-prod in Lambda console — if set below 500, immediately increase to 1000 or remove the reserved limit to use account-level concurrency

Check SQS queue depth for the quote-processor input queue RIGHT NOW — if depth exceeds 10K and is rising, this is trending toward P1 and you have less than 5 minutes before user-facing failures become severe

Check RDS connection metrics (DatabaseConnections, ReadLatency, WriteLatency) — if connections are near max or latency is elevated, the Lambda is holding connections too long causing retry storms; consider scaling RDS or killing idle connections via rds_admin
healthcare_impact: Insurance quote requests from members and brokers are failing or queuing during peak afternoon submission window — users attempting to get coverage quotes are receiving errors or timeouts, directly delaying enrollment decisions and potentially causing members to miss coverage windows.
escalate_if: SQS queue depth exceeds 100K messages, throttle count exceeds 1000 in any 5-minute window, RDS connection pool is at max capacity, or throttles persist beyond 15 minutes after concurrency limit adjustment
